sourceType.description: The full CloudEvents type of the governed source fact.

version.description: Append-only: 1 for the first declaration, +1 per accepted change.

severity.description: The triage outcome, from the policy or an operator.
severity.title: Severity

autoResolve.description: Null when the source type has no auto-resolve rule.

onType.description: The full CloudEvents type of the correlated fact that closes the case (e.g. OrderRepromised).

withinMinutes.description: The correlated fact counts only within this many minutes of the case's last occurrence.

400.description: Malformed JSON body, an unknown field, an invalid path, query or header parameter, or a NUL byte in a body.

schema.description: RFC 7807 problem document used for every non-2xx response.
schema.title: Problem

malformedBody.summary: Malformed JSON body or NUL byte

value.title: Malformed request body
value.detail: request body is not valid JSON for this operation

value.title: Severity is invalid
value.detail: severity must be one of LOW, MEDIUM, HIGH, CRITICAL

invalidResolution.summary: Missing resolution code or root cause

value.title: Resolution is invalid
value.detail: resolutionCode and rootCause must not be blank

value.title: Policy is invalid
value.detail: slaMinutes must be at least 1 and autoResolve.onType, when present, must be a full CloudEvents type

value.title: Source type is invalid
value.detail: sourceType must be a full CloudEvents type this service consumes

value.title: Case id is invalid
value.detail: case id must start with case- and have no whitespace, control characters or '/'

value.title: Status is invalid
value.detail: status must be one of OPEN, TRIAGED, ASSIGNED, RESOLVED

value.title: Idempotency-Key header is required
value.detail: send an Idempotency-Key header with a unique value per logical request
